# Test images

**No photo is committed to this repository**, and none must be (CLAUDE.md §5).

- The unit tests (`tests/*.test.ts`) use numbers and tiny generated arrays
  only; they need no image files.
- The screenshots in `docs/images/` show illustrated faces drawn with canvas
  shapes by a script. They depict no real person.
- Browser checks recorded in `docs/adr/` were run with images kept outside the
  repository:
  - illustrated faces generated on a canvas (as above);
  - public-domain NASA portraits from Wikimedia Commons, downloaded at
    1920 px width on 2026-11-14 and used only locally for calibration:
    - `Kalpana Chawla, NASA photo portrait in orange suit.jpg`
    - `Laurel Clark, NASA photo portrait in blue suit.jpg`
    - `NASA Administrator Bill Nelson Official Portrait (NHQ202105170001).jpg`
    - `Official portrait of NASA astronaut Jack Hathaway (jsc2025e068207 alt).jpg`
    - `NASA astronaut Leland D. Melvin with his dogs Jake and Scout.jpg`

If an image file is ever needed here, it must be synthetic or have a clear
licence, and its source and licence must be listed in this file.
